description: Curated public sources: World Bank India updates, MoSPI GDP estimates, an RBI policy summary (via PIB), and quarterly results press releases from Indian IT companies. Fetched at seed time through SETU's SSRF-safe, robots.txt-respecting importer; the files themselves are not redistributed in this repository.
